svg.title: Local Gap Limit
svg.desc: Two columns, each showing a fine mesh patch above a coarse one. Every mesh point carries a dashed red ring whose radius is half the contact gap, so two rings that overlap mean the two points are inside each other's contact layer. In the left column, with no limit, the same gap is drawn on both meshes: on the fine mesh the rings overlap their neighbors everywhere, on the coarse mesh they stay clear. In the right column, with the limit at 25 percent, the rings on the fine mesh are shrunk to a quarter of the triangle height and no longer touch, while the rings on the coarse mesh are unchanged.
svg.text: the same gap on every mesh
gap capped at a quarter of the mesh spacing
rings overlap: neighbors push each other apart
gap lowered here: neighbors stay clear
unchanged: the cap is above the gap
